title: Alien Sorcerer in Cosmic Studio
description: A green alien in ornate cream and red robes stands in a mystical studio, gesturing with both hands as a swirling vortex of rainbow smoke rises from the floor. Two smaller aliens row a wooden boat through the air, while a painting of the same scene leans against the wall beneath shelves of candles, potions, and hanging lanterns under a starry galaxy sky.
prompt: A tall green alien sorcerer wearing ornate cream robes with red and green trim stands in a dark mystical studio filled with hanging lanterns, candles, potion bottles and hanging herbs. He gestures magically as a swirling rainbow vortex of smoke rises from the floor around him. Two tiny green aliens row a small wooden boat floating in mid-air. A large painting showing the same boat scene leans against the wall. Cosmic starry galaxy visible through the window, smoke and magical atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art.
